issuer: the Chief of Police of Kosrae

licence.name: operator's license, class (b) (motor vehicles of 3,000 pounds gross or less)

note: Read 2026-11-03 on the FSM's Legal Information System (fsmlaw.org), in a browser (the site answers this client's plain fetch with Mod Security's 406). The LIS is run from the FSM Supreme Court (its office is in the Court's building in Palikir, its webmaster the Court's), and its codes are copies of the governments' official publications, as its disclaimer says, so it is read as the court's own legal register. Kosrae State Code, Title 17, Part I, ch. 3: § 17.301, the license fee is six dollars; § 17.302(2)(a)(1), an operator's license for a vehicle of class (b) (3,000 pounds gross or less) from sixteen; §§ 17.305 and 17.306, the Chief of Police examines the applicant, issues the license and keeps the register; § 17.308, the license is valid until its holder's birthday in the fourth calendar year after the year it's issued, held as four years. The learner's permit ($3, sixty days) isn't held; the chapter names no identification card.

sources.title: Kosrae State Code, Title 17 (The Public Safety), Part I, ch. 3 (Licensing), on the FSM Legal Information System
sources.said: Section 17.301. ... The license fee is six dollars. ... Section 17.302. ... (2) A person applying for a license: (a) has attained the age of: (1) sixteen years, in the case of an operator's license or learner's permit issued pursuant to paragraphs (a),(b),(c) or (d) of subsection 1 ... Section 17.305. (1) The Chief of Police examines an applicant for an operator's license and determines whether he is physically and mentally qualified to operate a motor vehicle in the class applied for before issuing a license for that class. ... Section 17.308. Term. An operator's license is valid until the birthday of the operator during the fourth calendar year following the year of issuance of the license.
